content:
In addition to launching macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple is also simultaneously rolling out macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8. Below are the highlights of this update.

"Important security patches"

Apple today officially launched macOS 27 Golden Gate, introducing an all-new Siri AI with dedicated applications, brand-new Apple Foundation Models, as well as a number of improvements to Safari and Shortcuts.

In addition, Apple has also released macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8. The company stated that both updates include "important security patches and recommends that all users install them".

Apple has not yet updated its security release page to list the specific contents of these updates. However, looking at Apple's recent track record with macOS security patches, particularly those addressing WebKit vulnerabilities, if you do not wish to or are unable to upgrade to macOS 27, installing the updates as soon as possible may be a wise choice.

The version numbers for macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8 are 25G229 and 24H23 respectively, consistent with the recent release candidates.
